description: Stages a fingerprint-protection profile for a Fleet and optionally schedules an immediate Client restart.

profileId.description: Fingerprint profile ID to stage, or null for system identity.

forceRestart.description: Whether to force restart the Fleet Client process immediately after staging (default: false).

fleetId.description: Fleet ID whose fingerprint policy was staged.

applied.description: Whether the policy was accepted by the Fleet.

restartRequested.description: Whether an immediate Client restart was requested.

restartRequired.description: Whether a restart is required before the policy takes effect.

policySummary.description: Sanitized summary of the staged fingerprint policy.

restartToken.description: Token identifying a scheduled restart, or null when none was scheduled.

status.description: Policy application or restart scheduling status.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.

fleetId.description: Fleet ID whose fingerprint policy was staged.

applied.description: Whether the policy was accepted by the Fleet.

restartRequested.description: Whether an immediate Client restart was requested.

restartRequired.description: Whether a restart is required before the policy takes effect.

policySummary.description: Sanitized summary of the staged fingerprint policy.

restartToken.description: Token identifying a scheduled restart, or null when none was scheduled.

status.description: Policy application or restart scheduling status.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Factual observation that does not expose private runtime diagnostics.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Action-specific public details; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
